title: Group-action divisibility: 'symmetry kills the count' (e2=0 / S3 BGK kernel / dilation eigenstack) is a shared action-theoretic skeleton with NO magnitude bound
reduced_to: An n-uniform bound on the RESIDUAL ORBIT COUNT N (= number of mu_n-coset Gauss-period orbits carrying large correlation) of the bad-scalar set above delta*. This is exactly Chai-Fan eprint 2026/861 conjecture Q2 (DISPROOF_LOG Loop43: prize <=> N<=K). The probe shows N grows (= m=(q-1)/n), so 'K=O(1)' is false; the surviving magnitude B=max over the N orbits = sqrt(n log(q/n)) IS the open BGK/Paley eigenvalue.
wall: W-BGK (the generalized-Paley / Gauss-period magnitude B = max_{b!=0}|sum_{y in mu_n} omega^{by}|; B<=2 sqrt n <=> Paley Graph Conjecture, open).
evidence: Two exact probes in scripts/probes/_407_conn/ at dyadic PROPER-subgroup primes (n=2^mu, q=1 mod n prime, q~n^4-5, n<<sqrt q). probe_C083_residual_orbit_count.py: the F5 energy kernel M=#{u in mu_n:-(1+u) in mu_n}=0 EXACTLY for n=8,16,32,64 across 3 dyadic primes each => S3-divisibility (3|M, proven in AdditiveEnergyThreeDvd.three_dvd_bgkCount) and parity (2|M) are VACUOUS in-regime (true only because M=0); N_S3=N_full=0. probe_C083_magnitude_vs_orbits.py (n=8..128): residual coset-orbit count m=(q-1)/n GROWS 516,4096,32769,262150,2097171 (~n^{beta-1}, NOT O(1)); the surviving magnitude B=max_b|Gauss period| grows 7.30,13.84,14.49,24.79,31.18 with B/sqrt(n) trending up (2.6,3.5,2.6,3.1,2.8) and B/sqrt(n ln(q/n)) flat (1.03,1.20,0.79,0.88,0.72) => B~sqrt(n log(q/n)), the open law. Confirms DISPROOF_LOG Loop20-22 (single orbit absorbed/linear; many-orbit balance = open) and Loop41-43 (Action-Orbit Thm 2.1 forces V_delta into orbits; prize <=> orbit-count bound N<=K = Q2, the open core).
honest_note: C083 is a CORRECT and genuinely insightful unification: all three faces (F12 e2=0 folded census, F5 S3 BGK kernel 3|M, F9 dilation eigenstack ord|#bad) really are one 'count = invariant of a finite group action' principle, and all three Lean lemmas are axiom-clean as stated. But the attack-plan's closure hope -- 'if the combined group forces residual orbit count K=O(1) above delta*, that is a non-analytic closure' -- is REFUTED by the probe: K grows like (q-1)/n. The symmetries quotient the bad set into coset/Gauss-period orbits but leave the MAGNITUDE (B, the max over those orbits) completely untouched, and that magnitude is the 25-year-open BGK/Paley sqrt-cancellation. The F5 face is additionally vacuous in the prize regime (M=0). NOT a closure. The honest outcome is a sharp restatement of the open core, not progress past it; this matches the in-tree record (Chai-Fan Q2, Loop43) rather than beating it. B was computed by Gauss-sum sampling (max over up to 400 coset reps), not exact full-max, so the precise constant is indicative; the kernel counts M and the orbit count m are exact.
